source: EPA CyAN satellite estimates (about 300 m pixels): nationwide images + per-lake pixel counts
note: i = newest bloom warning from EPA's nationwide images (kind d = daily, w = weekly, dated by its week's first day; pixels = image pixels in the outline). c = newest per-lake check (seen = pixels the satellite saw, below detection + detected; lakePixels = water pixels EPA can see). Dates are satellite image days; last100 = newest day with a pixel at 100,000+ cells/mL.
